newsitem.title: JAPAN: HK says ADB should focus on Asian financial sector.
newsitem.headline: HK says ADB should focus on Asian financial sector.

text.p: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) should put more emphasis on developing the financial sector of member nations, Joseph Yam, chief executive of the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, said on Monday.
He told the 30th annual meeting of the ADB that the bank should become more of a catalyst in the development process of member economies rather than a financier of development projects.
Building financial infrastructure was one measure the bank could take to that end, Yam said.
"The need to develop the financial sector, in particular the financial infrastructure, in this region is clearly there and a very significant if not a crucial one," he said.
Yam added that the development of financial infrastructure will also enable the ADB to efficiently channel the scarce resources of member countries.

The fact that in 1996 the bank extended only five loans totalling $213 million and 21 technical assistance grants worth $9.5 million in the field of developing the financial sector was of some concern, he said.
